findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and its status is recorded as dissolved, with cessation on 22 December 2025.
One insolvency case is on record: a members' voluntary liquidation, with the company wound up on 20 May 2025 and dissolved on 22 December 2025.
The register shows 1 current person with significant control, CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, with ownership of shares of 75 to 100 percent.
No charges are registered against the company.
The company has 2 current officers: 1 director, PERSON 268 (appointed 11 May 2022), and 1 other officer.
The director PERSON 268 holds 11 other appointments, of which 8 are active, 2 dissolved and 1 in liquidation; this may be incomplete because appointments are matched by officer ID.
The accounts were last made up to 31 December 2023 and the confirmation statement was last made up to 5 March 2025; their overdue status is unknown and no next due date is recorded.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations were filed since 24 October 2025.
